wlc: אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: verba Ecclesiastes filii David regis Hierusalem
clem: Verba Ecclesiast, filii David, regis Jerusalem.
kjv: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: vanitas vanitatum dixit Ecclesiastes vanitas vanitatum omnia vanitas
clem: [Vanitas vanitatum, dixit Ecclesiastes; vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas.
kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: quid habet amplius homo de universo labore suo quod laborat sub sole
clem: Quid habet amplius homo de universo labore suo quo laborat sub sole?]
kjv: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: generatio praeterit et generatio advenit terra vero in aeternum stat
clem: [Generatio prterit, et generatio advenit; terra autem in ternum stat.
kjv: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: oritur sol et occidit et ad locum suum revertitur ibique renascens
clem: Oritur sol et occidit, et ad locum suum revertitur; ibique renascens,
kjv: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: gyrat per meridiem et flectitur ad aquilonem lustrans universa circuitu pergit spiritus et in circulos suos regreditur
clem: gyrat per meridiem, et flectitur ad aquilonem. Lustrans universa in circuitu pergit spiritus, et in circulos suos revertitur.
kjv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: omnia flumina intrant mare et mare non redundat ad locum unde exeunt flumina revertuntur ut iterum fluant
clem: Omnia flumina intrant in mare, et mare non redundat; ad locum unde exeunt flumina revertuntur ut iterum fluant.
kjv: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: cunctae res difficiles non potest eas homo explicare sermone non saturatur oculus visu nec auris impletur auditu
clem: Cunct res difficiles; non potest eas homo explicare sermone. Non saturatur oculus visu, nec auris auditu impletur.
kjv: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: quid est quod fuit ipsum quod futurum est quid est quod factum est ipsum quod fiendum est
clem: Quid est quod fuit? Ipsum quod futurum est. Quid est quod factum est? Ipsum quod faciendum est.
kjv: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: nihil sub sole novum nec valet quisquam dicere ecce hoc recens est iam enim praecessit in saeculis quae fuerunt ante nos
clem: Nihil sub sole novum, nec valet quisquam dicere: Ecce hoc recens est: jam enim prcessit in sculis qu fuerunt ante nos.
kjv: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: non est priorum memoria sed nec eorum quidem quae postea futura sunt erit recordatio apud eos qui futuri sunt in novissimo
clem: Non est priorum memoria; sed nec eorum quidem qu postea futura sunt erit recordatio apud eos qui futuri sunt in novissimo.]
kjv: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: ego Ecclesiastes fui rex Israhel in Hierusalem
clem: [Ego Ecclesiastes fui rex Isral in Jerusalem;
kjv: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: et proposui in animo meo quaerere et investigare sapienter de omnibus quae fiunt sub sole hanc occupationem pessimam dedit Deus filiis hominum ut occuparentur in ea
clem: et proposui in animo meo qurere et investigare sapienter de omnibus qu fiunt sub sole. Hanc occupationem pessimam dedit Deus filiis hominum, ut occuparentur in ea.
kjv: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: vidi quae fiunt cuncta sub sole et ecce universa vanitas et adflictio spiritus
clem: Vidi cuncta qu fiunt sub sole, et ecce universa vanitas et afflictio spiritus.
kjv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: perversi difficile corriguntur et stultorum infinitus est numerus
clem: Perversi difficile corriguntur, et stultorum infinitus est numerus.
kjv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: locutus sum in corde meo dicens ecce magnus effectus sum et praecessi sapientia omnes qui fuerunt ante me in Hierusalem et mens mea contemplata est multa sapienter et didicit
clem: Locutus sum in corde meo, dicens: Ecce magnus effectus sum, et prcessi omnes sapientia qui fuerunt ante me in Jerusalem; et mens mea contemplata est multa sapienter, et didici.
kjv: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: dedique cor meum ut scirem prudentiam atque doctrinam erroresque et stultitiam et agnovi quod in his quoque esset labor et adflictio spiritus
clem: Dedique cor meum ut scirem prudentiam atque doctrinam, erroresque et stultitiam; et agnovi quod in his quoque esset labor et afflictio spiritus:
kjv: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
vulg: eo quod in multa sapientia multa sit indignatio et qui addit scientiam addat et laborem
clem: eo quod in multa sapientia multa sit indignatio; et qui addit scientiam, addit et laborem.]
kjv: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

wlc: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: dixi ego in corde meo vadam et affluam deliciis et fruar bonis et vidi quod hoc quoque esset vanitas
clem: [Dixi ego in corde meo: Vadam, et affluam deliciis, et fruar bonis; et vidi quod hoc quoque esset vanitas.
kjv: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: risum reputavi errorem et gaudio dixi quid frustra deciperis
clem: Risum reputavi errorem, et gaudio dixi: Quid frustra deciperis?
kjv: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: cogitavi in corde meo abstrahere a vino carnem meam ut animum meum transferrem ad sapientiam devitaremque stultitiam donec viderem quid esset utile filiis hominum quod facto opus est sub sole numero dierum vitae suae
clem: Cogitavi in corde meo abstrahere a vino carnem meam, ut animam meam transferrem ad sapientiam, devitaremque stultitiam, donec viderem quid esset utile filiis hominum, quo facto opus est sub sole numero dierum vit su.
kjv: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: magnificavi opera mea aedificavi mihi domos plantavi vineas
clem: Magnificavi opera mea, dificavi mihi domos, et plantavi vineas;
kjv: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: feci hortos et pomeria et consevi ea cuncti generis arboribus
clem: feci hortos et pomaria, et consevi ea cuncti generis arboribus;
kjv: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: extruxi mihi piscinas aquarum ut inrigarem silvam lignorum germinantium
clem: et exstruxi mihi piscinas aquarum, ut irrigarem silvam lignorum germinantium.
kjv: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: possedi servos et ancillas multamque familiam habui armenta quoque et magnos ovium greges ultra omnes qui fuerunt ante me in Hierusalem
clem: Possedi servos et ancillas, multamque familiam habui: armenta quoque, et magnos ovium greges, ultra omnes qui fuerunt ante me in Jerusalem;
kjv: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: coacervavi mihi argentum et aurum et substantias regum ac provinciarum feci mihi cantores et cantrices et delicias filiorum hominum scyphos et urceos in ministerio ad vina fundenda
clem: coacervavi mihi argentum et aurum, et substantias regum ac provinciarum; feci mihi cantores et cantatrices, et delicias filiorum hominum, scyphos, et urceos in ministerio ad vina fundenda;
kjv: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: et supergressus sum opibus omnes qui fuerunt ante me in Hierusalem sapientia quoque perseveravit mecum
clem: et supergressus sum opibus omnes qui ante me fuerunt in Jerusalem: sapientia quoque perseveravit mecum.
kjv: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: et omnia quae desideraverunt oculi mei non negavi eis nec prohibui cor quin omni voluptate frueretur et oblectaret se in his quae paraveram et hanc ratus sum partem meam si uterer labore meo
clem: Et omnia qu desideraverunt oculi mei non negavi eis, nec prohibui cor meum quin omni voluptate frueretur, et oblectaret se in his qu prparaveram; et hanc ratus sum partem meam si uterer labore meo.
kjv: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: cumque me convertissem ad universa opera quae fecerant manus meae et ad labores in quibus frustra sudaveram vidi in omnibus vanitatem et adflictionem animi et nihil permanere sub sole
clem: Cumque me convertissem ad universa opera qu fecerant manus me, et ad labores in quibus frustra sudaveram, vidi in omnibus vanitatem et afflictionem animi, et nihil permanere sub sole.]
kjv: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: transivi ad contemplandam sapientiam erroresque et stultitiam quid est inquam homo ut sequi possit regem factorem suum
clem: [Transivi ad contemplandam sapientiam, erroresque, et stultitiam. (Quid est, inquam, homo, ut sequi possit regem, factorem suum?)
kjv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: et vidi quia tantum praecederet sapientia stultitiam quantum differt lux tenebris
clem: Et vidi quod tantum prcederet sapientia stultitiam, quantum differt lux a tenebris.
kjv: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: sapientis oculi in capite eius stultus in tenebris ambulat et didici quod unus utriusque esset interitus
clem: Sapientis oculi in capite ejus; stultus in tenebris ambulat: et didici quod unus utriusque esset interitus.
kjv: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: et dixi in corde meo si unus et stulti et meus occasus erit quid mihi prodest quod maiorem sapientiae dedi operam locutusque cum mente mea animadverti quod hoc quoque esset vanitas
clem: Et dixi in corde meo: Si unus et stulti et meus occasus erit, quid mihi prodest quod majorem sapienti dedi operam? Locutusque cum mente mea, animadverti quod hoc quoque esset vanitas.
kjv: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: non enim erit memoria sapientis similiter ut stulti in perpetuum et futura tempora oblivione cuncta pariter obruent moritur doctus similiter et indoctus
clem: Non enim erit memoria sapientis similiter ut stulti in perpetuum, et futura tempora oblivione cuncta pariter operient: moritur doctus similiter ut indoctus.
kjv: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: et idcirco taeduit me vitae meae videntem mala esse universa sub sole et cuncta vanitatem atque adflictionem spiritus
clem: Et idcirco tduit me vit me, videntem mala universa esse sub sole, et cuncta vanitatem et afflictionem spiritus.]
kjv: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
vulg: rursum detestatus sum omnem industriam meam quae sub sole studiosissime laboravi habiturus heredem post me
clem: [Rursus detestatus sum omnem industriam meam, qua sub sole studiosissime laboravi, habiturus hredem post me,
kjv: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.

wlc: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: quem ignoro utrum sapiens an stultus futurus sit et dominabitur in laboribus meis quibus desudavi et sollicitus fui et est quicquam tam vanum
clem: quem ignoro utrum sapiens an stultus futurus sit, et dominabitur in laboribus meis, quibus desudavi et sollicitus fui: et est quidquam tam vanum?
kjv: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.

wlc: וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: unde cessavi renuntiavitque cor meum ultra laborare sub sole
clem: Unde cessavi, renuntiavitque cor meum ultra laborare sub sole.
kjv: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

wlc: כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
vulg: nam cum alius laboret in sapientia et doctrina et sollicitudine homini otioso quaesita dimittit et hoc ergo vanitas et magnum malum
clem: Nam cum alius laboret in sapientia, et doctrina, et sollicitudine, homini otioso qusita dimittit; et hoc ergo vanitas et magnum malum.
kjv: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.

wlc: כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: quid enim proderit homini de universo labore suo et adflictione spiritus qua sub sole cruciatus est
clem: Quid enim proderit homini de universo labore suo, et afflictione spiritus, qua sub sole cruciatus est?
kjv: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

wlc: כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
vulg: cuncti dies eius doloribus et aerumnis pleni sunt nec per noctem mente requiescit et haec non vanitas est
clem: Cuncti dies ejus doloribus et rumnis pleni sunt, nec per noctem mente requiescit. Et hoc nonne vanitas est?
kjv: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

wlc: אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
vulg: nonne melius est comedere et bibere et ostendere animae suae bona de laboribus suis et hoc de manu Dei est
clem: Nonne melius est comedere et bibere, et ostendere anim su bona de laboribus suis? et hoc de manu Dei est.
kjv: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.

wlc: כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
vulg: quis ita vorabit et deliciis affluet ut ego
clem: Quis ita devorabit et deliciis affluet ut ego?
kjv: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?

wlc: כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: homini bono in conspectu suo dedit Deus sapientiam et scientiam et laetitiam peccatori autem dedit adflictionem et curam superfluam ut addat et congreget et tradat ei qui placuit Deo sed et hoc vanitas et cassa sollicitudo mentis
clem: Homini bono in conspectu suo dedit Deus sapientiam, et scientiam, et ltitiam; peccatori autem dedit afflictionem et curam superfluam, ut addat, et congreget, et tradat ei qui placuit Deo; sed et hoc vanitas est, et cassa sollicitudo mentis.]
kjv: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: omnia tempus habent et suis spatiis transeunt universa sub caelo
clem: [Omnia tempus habent, et suis spatiis transeunt universa sub clo.
kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: tempus nascendi et tempus moriendi tempus plantandi et tempus evellendi quod plantatum est
clem: Tempus nascendi, et tempus moriendi; tempus plantandi, et tempus evellendi quod plantatum est.
kjv: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: tempus occidendi et tempus sanandi tempus destruendi et tempus aedificandi
clem: Tempus occidendi, et tempus sanandi; tempus destruendi, et tempus dificandi.
kjv: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: tempus flendi et tempus ridendi tempus plangendi et tempus saltandi
clem: Tempus flendi, et tempus ridendi; tempus plangendi, et tempus saltandi.
kjv: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: tempus spargendi lapides et tempus colligendi tempus amplexandi et tempus longe fieri a conplexibus
clem: Tempus spargendi lapides, et tempus colligendi, tempus amplexandi, et tempus longe fieri ab amplexibus.
kjv: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: tempus adquirendi et tempus perdendi tempus custodiendi et tempus abiciendi
clem: Tempus acquirendi, et tempus perdendi; tempus custodiendi, et tempus abjiciendi.
kjv: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: tempus scindendi et tempus consuendi tempus tacendi et tempus loquendi
clem: Tempus scindendi, et tempus consuendi; tempus tacendi, et tempus loquendi.
kjv: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: tempus dilectionis et tempus odii tempus belli et tempus pacis
clem: Tempus dilectionis, et tempus odii; tempus belli, et tempus pacis.]
kjv: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: quid habet amplius homo de labore suo
clem: [Quid habet amplius homo de labore suo?
kjv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: vidi adflictionem quam dedit Deus filiis hominum ut distendantur in ea
clem: Vidi afflictionem quam dedit Deus filiis hominum, ut distendantur in ea.
kjv: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: cuncta fecit bona in tempore suo et mundum tradidit disputationi eorum ut non inveniat homo opus quod operatus est Deus ab initio usque ad finem
clem: Cuncta fecit bona in tempore suo, et mundum tradidit disputationi eorum, ut non inveniat homo opus quod operatus est Deus ab initio usque ad finem.
kjv: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: et cognovi quod non esset melius nisi laetari et facere bene in vita sua
clem: Et cognovi quod non esset melius nisi ltari, et facere bene in vita sua;
kjv: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: omnis enim homo qui comedit et bibit et videt bonum de labore suo hoc donum Dei est
clem: omnis enim homo qui comedit et bibit, et videt bonum de labore suo, hoc donum Dei est.
kjv: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: didici quod omnia opera quae fecit Deus perseverent in perpetuum non possumus eis quicquam addere nec auferre quae fecit Deus ut timeatur
clem: Didici quod omnia opera qu fecit Deus perseverent in perpetuum; non possumus eis quidquam addere, nec auferre, qu fecit Deus ut timeatur.
kjv: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: quod factum est ipsum permanet quae futura sunt iam fuerunt et Deus instaurat quod abiit
clem: Quod factum est, ipsum permanet; qu futura sunt jam fuerunt, et Deus instaurat quod abiit.]
kjv: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: vidi sub sole in loco iudicii impietatem et in loco iustitiae iniquitatem
clem: [Vidi sub sole in loco judicii impietatem, et in loco justiti iniquitatem:
kjv: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: et dixi in corde meo iustum et impium iudicabit Deus et tempus omni rei tunc erit
clem: et dixi in corde meo: Justum et impium judicabit Deus, et tempus omnis rei tunc erit.
kjv: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
vulg: dixi in corde meo de filiis hominum ut probaret eos Deus et ostenderet similes esse bestiis
clem: Dixi in corde meo de filiis hominum, ut probaret eos Deus, et ostenderet similes esse bestiis.
kjv: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

wlc: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: idcirco unus interitus est hominis et iumentorum et aequa utriusque condicio sicut moritur homo sic et illa moriuntur similiter spirant omnia et nihil habet homo iumento amplius cuncta subiacent vanitati
clem: Idcirco unus interitus est hominis et jumentorum, et qua utriusque conditio. Sicut moritur homo, sic et illa moriuntur. Similiter spirant omnia, et nihil habet homo jumento amplius: cuncta subjacent vanitati,
kjv: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

wlc: וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: et omnia pergunt ad unum locum de terra facta sunt et in terram pariter revertentur
clem: et omnia pergunt ad unum locum. De terra facta sunt, et in terram pariter revertuntur.
kjv: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

wlc: כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
vulg: quis novit si spiritus filiorum Adam ascendat sursum et si spiritus iumentorum descendat deorsum
clem: Quis novit si spiritus filiorum Adam ascendat sursum, et si spiritus jumentorum descendat deorsum?
kjv: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

wlc: כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: et deprehendi nihil esse melius quam laetari hominem in opere suo et hanc esse partem illius quis enim eum adducet ut post se futura cognoscat
clem: Et deprehendi nihil esse melius quam ltari hominem in opere suo, et hanc esse partem illius. Quis enim eum adducet ut post se futura cognoscat?]
kjv: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

wlc: כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: verti me ad alia et vidi calumnias quae sub sole geruntur et lacrimas innocentum et consolatorem neminem nec posse resistere eorum violentiae cunctorum auxilio destitutos
clem: [Verti me ad alia, et vidi calumnias qu sub sole geruntur, et lacrimas innocentium, et neminem consolatorem, nec posse resistere eorum violenti, cunctorum auxilio destitutos,
kjv: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: et laudavi magis mortuos quam viventes
clem: et laudavi magis mortuos quam viventes;
kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: et feliciorem utroque iudicavi qui necdum natus est nec vidit mala quae sub sole fiunt
clem: et feliciorem utroque judicavi qui necdum natus est, nec vidit mala qu sub sole fiunt.
kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: rursum contemplatus omnes labores hominum et industrias animadverti patere invidiae proximi et in hoc ergo vanitas et cura superflua est
clem: Rursum contemplatus sum omnes labores hominum, et industrias animadverti patere invidi proximi; et in hoc ergo vanitas et cura superflua est.
kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: stultus conplicat manus suas et comedit carnes suas dicens
clem: Stultus complicat manus suas, et comedit carnes suas, dicens:
kjv: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: melior est pugillus cum requie quam plena utraque manus cum labore et adflictione animi
clem: Melior est pugillus cum requie, quam plena utraque manus cum labore et afflictione animi.
kjv: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: considerans repperi et aliam vanitatem sub sole
clem: Considerans, reperi et aliam vanitatem sub sole.
kjv: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: unus est et secundum non habet non filium non fratrem et tamen laborare non cessat nec satiantur oculi eius divitiis nec recogitat dicens cui laboro et fraudo animam meam bonis in hoc quoque vanitas est et adflictio pessima
clem: Unus est, et secundum non habet, non filium, non fratrem, et tamen laborare non cessat, nec satiantur oculi ejus divitiis; nec recogitat, dicens: Cui laboro, et fraudo animam meam bonis? In hoc quoque vanitas est et afflictio pessima.]
kjv: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: melius ergo est duos simul esse quam unum habent enim emolumentum societatis suae
clem: [Melius est ergo duos esse simul quam unum; habent enim emolumentum societatis su.
kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: si unus ceciderit ab altero fulcietur vae soli quia cum ruerit non habet sublevantem
clem: Si unus ceciderit, ab altero fulcietur. V soli, quia cum ceciderit, non habet sublevantem se.
kjv: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: et si dormierint duo fovebuntur mutuo unus quomodo calefiet
clem: Et si dormierint duo, fovebuntur mutuo; unus quomodo calefiet?
kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: et si quispiam praevaluerit contra unum duo resistent ei funiculus triplex difficile rumpitur
clem: Et si quispiam prvaluerit contra unum, duo resistunt ei; funiculus triplex difficile rumpitur.
kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: melior est puer pauper et sapiens rege sene et stulto qui nescit providere in posterum
clem: Melior est puer pauper et sapiens, rege sene et stulto, qui nescit prvidere in posterum.
kjv: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: quod et de carcere catenisque interdum quis egrediatur ad regnum et alius natus in regno inopia consumatur
clem: Quod de carcere catenisque interdum quis egrediatur ad regnum; et alius, natus in regno, inopia consumatur.
kjv: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: vidi cunctos viventes qui ambulant sub sole cum adulescente secundo qui consurgit pro eo
clem: Vidi cunctos viventes qui ambulant sub sole cum adolescente secundo, qui consurget pro eo.
kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: infinitus numerus est populi omnium qui fuerunt ante eum et qui postea futuri sunt non laetabuntur in eo sed et hoc vanitas et adflictio spiritus
clem: Infinitus numerus est populi omnium qui fuerunt ante eum, et qui postea futuri sunt non ltabuntur in eo; sed et hoc vanitas et afflictio spiritus.]
kjv: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: custodi pedem tuum ingrediens domum Dei multo enim melior est oboedientia quam stultorum victimae qui nesciunt quid faciant mali
clem: [Custodi pedem tuum ingrediens domum Dei, et appropinqua ut audias. Multo enim melior est obedientia quam stultorum victim, qui nesciunt quid faciunt mali.]

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: ne temere quid loquaris neque cor tuum sit velox ad proferendum sermonem coram Deo Deus enim in caelo et tu super terram idcirco sint pauci sermones tui
clem: [Ne temere quid loquaris, neque cor tuum sit velox ad proferendum sermonem coram Deo. Deus enim in clo, et tu super terram; idcirco sint pauci sermones tui.
kjv: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: multas curas sequuntur somnia et in multis sermonibus invenitur stultitia
clem: Multas curas sequuntur somnia, et in multis sermonibus invenietur stultitia.
kjv: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: si quid vovisti Deo ne moreris reddere displicet enim ei infidelis et stulta promissio sed quodcumque voveris redde
clem: Si quid vovisti Deo, ne moreris reddere: displicet enim ei infidelis et stulta promissio, sed quodcumque voveris redde:
kjv: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: multoque melius est non vovere quam post votum promissa non conplere
clem: multoque melius est non vovere, quam post votum promissa non reddere.
kjv: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: ne dederis os tuum ut peccare faciat carnem tuam neque dicas coram angelo non est providentia ne forte iratus Deus super sermone tuo dissipet cuncta opera manuum tuarum
clem: Ne dederis os tuum ut peccare facias carnem tuam, neque dicas coram angelo: Non est providentia: ne forte iratus Deus contra sermones tuos dissipet cuncta opera manuum tuarum.
kjv: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: ubi multa sunt somnia plurimae vanitates et sermones innumeri tu vero Deum time
clem: Ubi multa sunt somnia, plurim sunt vanitates, et sermones innumeri; tu vero Deum time.]
kjv: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: si videris calumnias egenorum et violenta iudicia et subverti iustitiam in provincia non mireris super hoc negotio quia excelso alius excelsior est et super hos quoque eminentiores sunt alii
clem: [Si videris calumnias egenorum, et violenta judicia, et subverti justitiam in provincia, non mireris super hoc negotio: quia excelso excelsior est alius, et super hos quoque eminentiores sunt alii;
kjv: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: et insuper universae terrae rex imperat servienti
clem: et insuper univers terr rex imperat servienti.
kjv: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: avarus non implebitur pecunia et qui amat divitias fructus non capiet ex eis et hoc ergo vanitas
clem: Avarus non implebitur pecunia, et qui amat divitias fructum non capiet ex eis; et hoc ergo vanitas.
kjv: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: ubi multae sunt opes multi et qui comedant eas et quid prodest possessori nisi quod cernit divitias oculis suis
clem: Ubi mult sunt opes, multi et qui comedunt eas. Et quid prodest possessori, nisi quod cernit divitias oculis suis?
kjv: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: dulcis est somnus operanti sive parum sive multum comedat saturitas autem divitis non sinit dormire eum
clem: Dulcis est somnus operanti, sive parum sive multum comedat; saturitas autem divitis non sinit eum dormire.]
kjv: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: est et alia infirmitas pessima quam vidi sub sole divitiae conservatae in malum domini sui
clem: [Est et alia infirmitas pessima quam vidi sub sole: diviti conservat in malum domini sui.
kjv: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: pereunt enim in adflictione pessima generavit filium qui in summa egestate erit
clem: Pereunt enim in afflictione pessima: generavit filium qui in summa egestate erit.
kjv: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: sicut egressus est nudus de utero matris suae sic revertetur et nihil auferet secum de labore suo
clem: Sicut egressus est nudus de utero matris su, sic revertetur, et nihil auferet secum de labore suo.
kjv: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: miserabilis prorsus infirmitas quomodo venit sic revertetur quid ergo prodest ei quod laboravit in ventum
clem: Miserabilis prorsus infirmitas: quomodo venit, sic revertetur. Quid ergo prodest ei quod laboravit in ventum?
kjv: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: cunctis diebus vitae suae comedit in tenebris et in curis multis et in aerumna atque tristitia
clem: cunctis diebus vit su comedit in tenebris, et in curis multis, et in rumna atque tristitia.]
kjv: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: hoc itaque mihi visum est bonum ut comedat quis et bibat et fruatur laetitia ex labore suo quod laboravit ipse sub sole numerum dierum vitae suae quos dedit ei Deus et haec est pars illius
clem: [Hoc itaque visum est mihi bonum, ut comedat quis et bibat, et fruatur ltitia ex labore suo quo laboravit ipse sub sole, numero dierum vit su quos dedit ei Deus; et hc est pars illius.
kjv: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
vulg: et omni homini cui dedit Deus divitias atque substantiam potestatemque ei tribuit ut comedat ex eis et fruatur parte sua et laetetur de labore suo hoc est donum Dei
clem: Et omni homini cui dedit Deus divitias atque substantiam, potestatemque ei tribuit ut comedat ex eis, et fruatur parte sua, et ltetur de labore suo: hoc est donum Dei.
kjv: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.

wlc: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: non enim satis recordabitur dierum vitae suae eo quod Deus occupet deliciis cor eius
clem: Non enim satis recordabitur dierum vit su, eo quod Deus occupet deliciis cor ejus.]
kjv: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.

wlc: וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
kjv: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.

wlc: כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: est et aliud malum quod vidi sub sole et quidem frequens apud homines
clem: [Est et aliud malum quod vidi sub sole, et quidem frequens apud homines:
kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: vir cui dedit Deus divitias et substantiam et honorem et nihil deest animae eius ex omnibus quae desiderat nec tribuit ei potestatem Deus ut comedat ex eo sed homo extraneus vorabit illud hoc vanitas et magna miseria est
clem: vir cui dedit Deus divitias, et substantiam, et honorem, et nihil deest anim su ex omnibus qu desiderat; nec tribuit ei potestatem Deus ut comedat ex eo, sed homo extraneus vorabit illud: hoc vanitas et miseria magna est.
kjv: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: si genuerit quispiam centum et vixerit multos annos et plures dies aetatis habuerit et anima illius non utatur bonis substantiae suae sepulturaque careat de hoc ego pronuntio quod melior illo sit abortivus
clem: Si genuerit quispiam centum liberos, et vixerit multos annos, et plures dies tatis habuerit, et anima illius non utatur bonis substanti su, sepulturaque careat: de hoc ergo pronuntio quod melior illo sit abortivus.
kjv: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: frustra enim venit et pergit ad tenebras et oblivione delebitur nomen eius
clem: Frustra enim venit, et pergit ad tenebras, et oblivione delebitur nomen ejus.
kjv: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: non vidit solem neque cognovit distantiam boni et mali
clem: Non vidit solem, neque cognovit distantiam boni et mali.
kjv: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: etiam si duobus milibus annis vixerit et non fuerit perfruitus bonis nonne ad unum locum properant omnia
clem: Etiam si duobus millibus annis vixerit, et non fuerit perfruitus bonis, nonne ad unum locum properant omnia?
kjv: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: omnis labor hominis in ore eius sed anima illius non impletur
clem: Omnis labor hominis in ore ejus; sed anima ejus non implebitur.
kjv: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: quid habet amplius sapiens ab stulto et quid pauper nisi ut pergat illuc ubi est vita
clem: Quid habet amplius sapiens a stulto? et quid pauper, nisi ut pergat illuc ubi est vita?
kjv: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: melius est videre quod cupias quam desiderare quod nescias sed et hoc vanitas est et praesumptio spiritus
clem: Melius est videre quod cupias, quam desiderare quod nescias. Sed et hoc vanitas est, et prsumptio spiritus.
kjv: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: qui futurus est iam vocatum est nomen eius et scitur quod homo sit et non possit contra fortiorem se in iudicio contendere
clem: Qui futurus est, jam vocatum est nomen ejus; et scitur quod homo sit, et non possit contra fortiorem se in judicio contendere.
kjv: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: verba sunt plurima multa in disputando habentia vanitatem
clem: Verba sunt plurima, multamque in disputando habentia vanitatem.]
kjv: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
kjv: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: quid necesse est homini maiora se quaerere cum ignoret quid conducat sibi in vita sua numero dierum peregrinationis suae et tempore quo velut umbra praeterit aut quis ei poterit indicare quid post eum futurum sub sole sit
clem: [Quid necesse est homini majora se qurere, cum ignoret quid conducat sibi in vita sua, numero dierum peregrinationis su, et tempore quod velut umbra prterit? aut quis ei poterit indicare quod post eum futurum sub sole sit?
kjv: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: melius est nomen bonum quam unguenta pretiosa et dies mortis die nativitatis
clem: Melius est nomen bonum quam unguenta pretiosa, et dies mortis die nativitatis.
kjv: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: melius est ire ad domum luctus quam ad domum convivii in illa enim finis cunctorum admonetur hominum et vivens cogitat quid futurum sit
clem: Melius est ire ad domum luctus quam ad domum convivii; in illa enim finis cunctorum admonetur hominum, et vivens cogitat quid futurum sit.
kjv: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: melior est ira risu quia per tristitiam vultus corrigitur animus delinquentis
clem: Melior est ira risu, quia per tristitiam vultus corrigitur animus delinquentis.
kjv: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: cor sapientium ubi tristitia est et cor stultorum ubi laetitia
clem: Cor sapientium ubi tristitia est, et cor stultorum ubi ltitia.
kjv: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: melius est a sapiente corripi quam stultorum adulatione decipi
clem: Melius est a sapiente corripi, quam stultorum adulatione decipi;
kjv: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: quia sicut sonitus spinarum ardentium sub olla sic risus stulti sed et hoc vanitas
clem: quia sicut sonitus spinarum ardentium sub olla, sic risus stulti. Sed et hoc vanitas.
kjv: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: calumnia conturbat sapientem et perdet robur cordis illius
clem: Calumnia conturbat sapientem, et perdet robur cordis illius.
kjv: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: melior est finis orationis quam principium melior est patiens arrogante
clem: Melior est finis orationis quam principium. Melior est patiens arrogante.
kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: ne velox sis ad irascendum quia ira in sinu stulti requiescit
clem: Ne sis velox ad irascendum, quia ira in sinu stulti requiescit.
kjv: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: ne dicas quid putas causae est quod priora tempora meliora fuere quam nunc sunt stulta est enim huiuscemodi interrogatio
clem: Ne dicas: Quid putas caus est quod priora tempora meliora fuere quam nunc sunt? stulta enim est hujuscemodi interrogatio.
kjv: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: utilior est sapientia cum divitiis et magis prodest videntibus solem
clem: Utilior est sapientia cum divitiis, et magis prodest videntibus solem.
kjv: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: sicut enim protegit sapientia sic protegit pecunia hoc autem plus habet eruditio et sapientia quod vitam tribuunt possessori suo
clem: Sicut enim protegit sapientia, sic protegit pecunia; hoc autem plus habet eruditio et sapientia, quod vitam tribuunt possessori suo.
kjv: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: considera opera Dei quod nemo possit corrigere quem ille despexerit
clem: Considera opera Dei, quod nemo possit corrigere quem ille despexerit.
kjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: in die bona fruere bonis et malam diem praecave sicut enim hanc sic et illam fecit Deus ut non inveniat homo contra eum iustas querimonias
clem: In die bona fruere bonis, et malam diem prcave; sicut enim hanc, sic et illam fecit Deus, ut non inveniat homo contra eum justas querimonias.
kjv: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.

wlc: כִּי אֵין זִכְרוֹן לֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל לְעוֹלָם בְּשֶׁכְּבָר הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים הַכֹּל נִשְׁכָּח וְאֵיךְ יָמוּת הֶחָכָם עִם־הַכְּסִיל ׃
vulg: haec quoque vidi in diebus vanitatis meae iustus perit in iustitia sua et impius multo vivit tempore in malitia sua
clem: Hc quoque vidi in diebus vanitatis me: justus perit in justitia sua, et impius multo vivit tempore in malitia sua.
kjv: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת־הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּי־הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: noli esse iustus multum neque plus sapias quam necesse est ne obstupescas
clem: Noli esse justus multum, neque plus sapias quam necesse est, ne obstupescas.
kjv: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?

wlc: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֲנִי אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁאֲנִי עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁאַנִּיחֶנּוּ לָאָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחֲרָי ׃
vulg: ne impie agas multum et noli esse stultus ne moriaris in tempore non tuo
clem: Ne impie agas multum, et noli esse stultus, ne moriaris in tempore non tuo.
kjv: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.

wlc: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל־עֲמָלִי שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: bonum est te sustentare iustum sed et ab illo ne subtrahas manum tuam quia qui Deum timet nihil neglegit
clem: Bonum est te sustentare justum: sed et ab illo ne subtrahas manum tuam; quia qui timet Deum nihil negligit.
kjv: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.

wlc: וְסַבּוֹתִי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת־לִבִּי עַל כָּל־הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: sapientia confortabit sapientem super decem principes civitatis
clem: Sapientia confortavit sapientem super decem principes civitatis;
kjv: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

wlc: כִּי־יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בְּחָכְמָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכִשְׁרוֹן וּלְאָדָם שֶׁלֹּא עָמַל־בּוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ חֶלְקוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וְרָעָה רַבָּה ׃
vulg: non est enim homo iustus in terra qui faciat bonum et non peccet
clem: non est enim homo justus in terra qui faciat bonum et non peccet.
kjv: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:

wlc: כִּי מֶה־הוֶֹה לָאָדָם בְּכָל־עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: sed et cunctis sermonibus qui dicuntur ne accommodes cor tuum ne forte audias servum tuum maledicentem tibi
clem: Sed et cunctis sermonibus qui dicuntur ne accomodes cor tuum, ne forte audias servum tuum maledicentem tibi;
kjv: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

wlc: כִּי כָל־יָמָיו מַכְאֹבִים וָכַעַס עִנְיָנוֹ גַּם־בַּלַּיְלָה לֹא־שָׁכַב לִבּוֹ גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל הוּא ׃
vulg: scit enim tua conscientia quia et tu crebro maledixisti aliis
clem: scit enim conscientia tua quia et tu crebro maledixisti aliis.
kjv: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.

wlc: אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ טוֹב בַּעֲמָלוֹ גַּם־זֹה רָאִיתִי אָנִי כִּי מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הִיא ׃
vulg: cuncta temptavi in sapientia dixi sapiens efficiar et ipsa longius recessit a me
clem: Cuncta tentavi in sapientia. Dixi: Sapiens efficiar: et ipsa longius recessit a me,
kjv: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?

wlc: כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי ׃
vulg: multo magis quam erat et alta profunditas quis inveniet eam
clem: multo magis quam erat. Et alta profunditas, quis inveniet eam?]
kjv: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:

wlc: כִּי לְאָדָם שֶׁטּוֹב לְפָנָיו נָתַן חָכְמָה וְדַעַת וְשִׂמְחָה וְלַחוֹטֶא נָתַן עִנְיָן לֶאֱסוֹף וְלִכְנוֹס לָתֵת לְטוֹב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים גַּם־זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ ׃
vulg: lustravi universa animo meo ut scirem et considerarem et quaererem sapientiam et rationem et ut cognoscerem impietatem stulti et errorem inprudentium
clem: [Lustravi universa animo meo, ut scirem et considerarem, et qurerem sapientiam, et rationem, et ut cognoscerem impietatem stulti, et errorem imprudentium:
kjv: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

vulg: et inveni amariorem morte mulierem quae laqueus venatorum est et sagena cor eius vincula sunt manus illius qui placet Deo effugiet eam qui autem peccator est capietur ab illa
clem: et inveni amariorem morte mulierem, qu laqueus venatorum est, et sagena cor ejus; vincula sunt manus illius. Qui placet Deo effugiet illam; qui autem peccator est capietur ab illa.
kjv: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:

vulg: ecce hoc inveni dicit Ecclesiastes unum et alterum ut invenirem rationem
clem: Ecce hoc inveni, dixit Ecclesiastes, unum et alterum ut invenirem rationem,
kjv: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

vulg: quam adhuc quaerit anima mea et non inveni virum de mille unum repperi mulierem ex omnibus non inveni
clem: quam adhuc qurit anima mea, et non inveni. Virum de mille unum reperi; mulierem ex omnibus non inveni.
kjv: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

vulg: solummodo hoc inveni quod fecerit Deus hominem rectum et ipse se infinitis miscuerit quaestionibus quis talis ut sapiens est et quis cognovit solutionem verbi
clem: Solummodo hoc inveni, quod fecerit Deus hominem rectum, et ipse se infinitis miscuerit qustionibus. Quis talis ut sapiens est? et quis cognovit solutionem verbi?]

wlc: אָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי לְכָה־נָּא אֲנַסְּכָה בְשִׂמְחָה וּרְאֵה בְטוֹב וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא הָבֶל ׃
vulg: sapientia hominis lucet in vultu eius et potentissimus faciem illius commutavit
clem: [Sapientia hominis lucet in vultu ejus, et potentissimus faciem illius commutabit.
kjv: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

wlc: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה־זֹּה עֹשָׂה ׃
vulg: ego os regis observo et praecepta iuramenti Dei
clem: Ego os regis observo, et prcepta juramenti Dei.
kjv: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.

wlc: תַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי לִמְשׁוֹךְ בַּיַּיִן אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי וְלִבִּי נֹהֵג בַּחָכְמָה וְלֶאֱחֹז בְּסִכְלוּת עַד אֲשֶׁר־אֶרְאֶה אֵי־זֶה טוֹב לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִסְפַּר יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם ׃
vulg: ne festines recedere a facie eius neque permaneas in opere malo quia omne quod voluerit faciet
clem: Ne festines recedere a facie ejus, neque permaneas in opere malo: quia omne quod voluerit faciet.
kjv: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

wlc: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִים ׃
vulg: et sermo illius potestate plenus est nec dicere ei quisquam potest quare ita facis
clem: Et sermo illius potestate plenus est, nec dicere ei quisquam potest: Quare ita facis?
kjv: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל־פֶּרִי ׃
vulg: qui custodit praeceptum non experietur quicquam mali tempus et responsionem cor sapientis intellegit
clem: Qui custodit prceptum non experietur quidquam mali. Tempus et responsionem cor sapientis intelligit.
kjv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.

wlc: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִים ׃
vulg: omni negotio tempus est et oportunitas et multa hominis adflictio
clem: Omni negotio tempus est, et opportunitas: et multa hominis afflictio,
kjv: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.

wlc: קָנִיתִי עֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת וּבְנֵי־בַיִת הָיָה לִי גַּם מִקְנֶה בָקָר וָצֹאן הַרְבֵּה הָיָה לִי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיוּ לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
vulg: quia ignorat praeterita et ventura nullo scire potest nuntio
clem: quia ignorat prterita, et futura nullo scire potest nuntio.
kjv: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?

wlc: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם־כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֹת ׃
vulg: non est in hominis dicione prohibere spiritum nec habet potestatem in die mortis nec sinitur quiescere ingruente bello neque salvabit impietas impium
clem: Non est in hominis potestate prohibere spiritum, nec habet potestatem in die mortis: nec sinitur quiescere ingruente bello, neque salvabit impietas impium.]
kjv: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

wlc: וְגָדַלְתִּי וְהוֹסַפְתִּי מִכֹּל שֶׁהָיָה לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַף חָכְמָתִי עָמְדָה לִּי ׃
vulg: omnia haec consideravi et dedi cor meum in cunctis operibus quae fiunt sub sole interdum dominatur homo homini in malum suum
clem: [Omnia hc consideravi, et dedi cor meum in cunctis operibus qu fiunt sub sole. Interdum dominatur homo homini in malum suum.
kjv: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

wlc: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאֲלוּ עֵינַי לֹא אָצַלְתִּי מֵהֶם לֹא־מָנַעְתִּי אֶת־לִבִּי מִכָּל־שִׂמְחָה כִּי־לִבִּי שָׂמֵחַ מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי וְזֶה־הָיָה חֶלְקִי מִכָּל־עֲמָלִי ׃
vulg: vidi impios sepultos qui etiam cum adviverent in loco sancto erant et laudabantur in civitate quasi iustorum operum sed et hoc vanitas est
clem: Vidi impios sepultos, qui etiam cum adhuc viverent in loco sancto erant, et laudabantur in civitate quasi justorum operum. Sed et hoc vanitas est.
kjv: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשַׂי שֶׁעָשׂוּ יָדַי וּבֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ וְאֵין יִתְרוֹן תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ ׃
vulg: etenim quia non profertur cito contra malos sententia absque ullo timore filii hominum perpetrant mala
clem: Etenim quia non profertur cito contra malos sententia, absque timore ullo filii hominum perpetrant mala.
kjv: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

wlc: וּפָנִיתִי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־כְּבָר עָשׂוּהוּ ׃
vulg: attamen ex eo quod peccator centies facit malum et per patientiam sustentatur ego cognovi quod erit bonum timentibus Deum qui verentur faciem eius
clem: Attamen peccator ex eo quod centies facit malum, et per patientiam sustentatur; ego cognovi quod erit bonum timentibus Deum, qui verentur faciem ejus.
kjv: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

wlc: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַחָכְמָה מִן־הַסִּכְלוּת כִּיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן־הַחֹשֶׁךְ ׃
vulg: non sit bonum impio nec prolongentur dies eius sed quasi umbra transeant qui non timent faciem Dei
clem: Non sit bonum impio, nec prolongentur dies ejus, sed quasi umbra transeant qui non timent faciem Domini.
kjv: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

wlc: הֶחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם ׃
vulg: est et alia vanitas quae fit super terram sunt iusti quibus multa proveniunt quasi opera egerint impiorum et sunt impii qui ita securi sunt quasi iustorum facta habeant sed et hoc vanissimum iudico
clem: Est et alia vanitas qu fit super terram: sunt justi quibus mala proveniunt quasi opera egerint impiorum: et sunt impii qui ita securi sunt quasi justorum facta habeant. Sed et hoc vanissimum judico.
kjv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.

wlc: וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם־אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶה הָבֶל ׃
vulg: laudavi igitur laetitiam quod non esset homini bonum sub sole nisi quod comederet et biberet atque gauderet et hoc solum secum auferret de labore suo in diebus vitae quos dedit ei Deus sub sole
